items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: He was there for a little while when I first came there, yeah. He’s a nice guy.

ctx.x: And what about Joe Williams? I know he was with Hampton for a while but it might have been —
Yeah. He was there for a little while when I first came there, yeah. He’s a nice guy.
Well what was it — people talk about Benny Goodman being difficult to deal with. Was it the same with Hampton? What was hard?
